name: flowstate-diagram
description: flowstate diagram pack (optional, off until switched on): diagram (draw architecture, flow, sequence, state and ER diagrams as Mermaid, tie each node to a source line with `%% src:` comments, and check them with the Mermaid CLI and diagram-check.mjs before handing them over). Needs mermaid-cli installed by the user (npm install @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli, Node 22.13 or later); without it the static checks still run.
